messages:
emma-sales: Hi team — trying to get ACME trial POC set up. They need a billing project + spend cap and ephemeral API keys. Can we confirm the flow and who does what?

jordan-solutions: I talked to them earlier. Requirements: 100k token free credits, hard spend cap at $200/month for the POC, ephemeral keys for devs, and optional Dedicated pool access if performance testing. They also asked about VPC gating for traffic to dedicated.

mike-infra: For ephemeral keys we can create a trial project under the sales org and mint ephemeral keys scoped to that project. Devs get 12-hr TTL keys. Need to confirm RBAC for who can create keys.

emma-sales: RBAC — they want 2 engineers with full usage, 1 product manager view-only. Is that easy?

mike-infra: Yep. We can create three service accounts: poc-engineer (write), poc-engineer2 (write), poc-pm (read). I just need the user emails. Also note: ephemeral keys are tied to project quotas.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created trial-project r-17183-acme-poc (id: r-17183). Default quota set to 50k tokens.

jordan-solutions: ops-bot shows 50k default — we need 100k. Olívia, can you raise the credits?

olivia-finops: I can top up to 100k credits for the trial project. Do we want to do that as free credits or as a prepaid invoice that we will absorb?

emma-sales: Free credits from promo budget. Please set a hard spend cap at $200/month on the project so they can't exceed POC budget.

olivia-finops: A hard spend cap means we need to attach a spend-shield policy. I can apply spendcap=200 USD and enable alerts at 50/80/100%. Any reason to use spendguard instead?

jordan-solutions: Alerts are fine. We do want automatic blocking at 100% so they don't get overage surprises.

olivia-finops: Done. I'll set alerts and hard block at $200.

mike-infra: For Dedicated pool access — if ACME wants to run performance tests we can route their project to a dedicated pool (requires a dedicated tenant). That needs approval from eng-runtime and provisioning lead. That will take 3-5 business days.

emma-sales: They may ask for a VPC peering option for Dedicated. Nate, any blockers from security?

nate-security: VPC peering for Dedicated is supported but we need IP allowlists and an IPsec tunnel for on-prem. For POC we usually recommend VPC egress restrictions + private endpoints instead of full peering. Also need their SOC2 questionnaire answers before we do any on-prem connectivity.

jordan-solutions: ACME's security team asked for answers to the network section of the questionnaire (network diagrams, ingress/egress controls). I can send our standard pack but we need to confirm the Dedicated/VPC plan to include in the doc.

emma-sales: Action items: 1) @jordan compile the network Q&A draft; 2) @mike-infra create the three service accounts and ephemeral keys; 3) @olivia-finops apply 100k promo credits + hard $200 spend cap; 4) @nate-security review the network section and sign off on recommended POC connectivity (private endpoint preferred).

mike-infra: I'll create the service accounts and post the key creation commands here. Example:
```
# create service account
rctl iam svc create poc-engineer --project r-17183
# mint ephemeral key
rctl auth ephemeral-mint --svc poc-engineer --ttl 12h
```
I'll add the emails and push the TTLed keys to a secure share.

ops-bot: audit-bot: audit log entry created for project r-17183 at 1718309401 by mike-infra.

olivia-finops: Credits and spendcap updated: credits=100000 tokens, spendcap=200 USD (hard block). I also set billing alerts to team@sales and finops@sales at 50/80/100%.

jordan-solutions: I'll draft the network section and attach the standard diagram. Emma — can you give me the two engineer emails and the PM email?

emma-sales: Sent via DM.

nate-security: I'll review the draft this afternoon. If they insist on VPC peering we'll need the questionnaires answered plus a support ticket for tunnel setup.

emma-sales: small note — ACME asked if Dedicated access is billable during POC. Should we quota hours or bill them?

olivia-finops: For POC we can grant a complimentary Dedicated trial for up to 3 days of peak testing; beyond that we either bill at discounted rate or schedule an explicit reserved window. I'll flag for approval.

jordan-solutions: Good. I'll mention the 3-day complimentary dedicated access in the SOW draft.

emma-sales: Thanks all — keeping this thread for updates. If anything blocks please ping me directly. :thumbsup:
